about_the_game:
Enjoy the soundtrack of NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii, composed by Ramón López and featuring a track with vocals by Raquel Pérez. Spanning 48 pieces and over an hour of music, this score offers a rich, immersive experience.

The music of NODE is deeply atmospheric and dark. It’s meant to accompany you at key moments during your journey through the Soviet ruins of Toska—not to play constantly. These are sonic brushstrokes, echoes of the past without recognizable melodies or recurring themes, designed to transport you to forgotten places.
